name: LUCI Head Tracking for Dramatic Shape
description: Head-tracked off-axis camera for the Dramatic Shape Voxel Mod, driven by LUCI Bar's local head-pose broker (ws://127.0.0.1:8765). The voxel overworld and staged battles become a window into a diorama that responds to where you actually are. Requires DRAMATIC_SHAPE and the LUCI Bar app.
